recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the FM work group later changes addItem detail-level service date/location semantics; no current FHIR core correction is indicated for FHIR-17483.
issue_request: FHIR-17483 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution requesting ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit addItem support for unsolicited preauthorization detail: a three-tier addItem/detail/subDetail structure like Claim, key line details, service dates and service locations, plus addItem.provider 0..* Reference(Practitioner|PractitionerRole|Organization) and removal of programCode from AddItemDetail and AddItemSubDetail.
initial_application: Git commit 52fcd5d684fd0a74f2975afc416f000f0c7daffb (Tracker #17483) applied the issue to the then-authoritative ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit spreadsheet sources by adding addItem.provider and marking addItem.detail.programCode and addItem.detail.subDetail.programCode as removed. Later source rework migrated the resource definitions into the current StructureDefinition XML files.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit as active resources and approved artifacts. The current XML contains addItem.provider with Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and Organization targets; contains addItem.detail and addItem.detail.subDetail tiers with line-detail elements; keeps serviced[x] and location[x] at addItem level; and has no addItem.detail.programCode or addItem.detail.subDetail.programCode. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later reversal or conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edits were needed because the current authoritative source already matches the published issue and its modification.
